title: centaurea × subdecurrens subsp. albuferae
intro: Centaurea × subdecurrens subsp. albuferae, commonly known as a plant species, is a type of Knapweed that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve soothing digestive issues, reducing pain, and promoting wound healing, thanks to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
